_note: Zikir Set 1, first three rows. All three are Qur'anic, so the Arabic comes from the export and nothing here is typed scripture. None of them carries a transmitted count — the istirja' is said when the news reaches you, not a set number of times — so each writes count: null and the card keeps an open tally instead of a target. The remembrances that DO carry counts (tasbih 33, istighfar, salawat, la hawla) are hadith and wait on SUNNAH_API_KEY. tr is the api.quran.com per-word transliteration sliced at the same fromWord index as the Arabic; en and my are trimmed to the clause the cut word begins.
pen: What they said when they were told the armies had gathered — and it increased them in faith.
ken: Said when you are told how bad it is: the diagnosis, the letter, the odds against you. It answers the fear rather than the news.
aen: Spoken by the companions after Uhud, when word reached them that the enemy was regrouping to return. The verse records their reply, not their alarm.
p: Apa yang mereka ucapkan ketika diberitahu tentera telah berkumpul — dan ia menambahkan iman mereka.
keg: Dibaca ketika diberitahu betapa buruk keadaannya: diagnosis, surat, kemungkinan yang menentang anda. Ia menjawab rasa takut itu, bukan beritanya.
asb: Diucapkan oleh para sahabat selepas Uhud, ketika sampai khabar bahawa musuh berkumpul semula untuk kembali. Ayat ini merakam jawapan mereka, bukan keresahan mereka.
art: A single lamp left on in a dark house, seen from outside through a window. Nothing threatening in frame, no person.
en: Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.
my: Cukuplah untuk (menolong) kami, dan Ia sebaik-baik pengurus (yang terserah kepadaNya segala urusan kami).

_note: The supplication of Yunus, called from inside the darknesses. The slice runs from word 15 to the end of the ayah.
ten: There Is No God But You
pen: Yunus in the dark, naming God first and himself second.
ken: Said when the trouble is of your own making and you know it. It admits the fault without arguing the case.
aen: Called out from inside the fish, in the darknesses of night, sea and belly — after he had left his people in anger.
p: Yunus dalam kegelapan, menyebut Allah dahulu dan dirinya kemudian.
keg: Dibaca ketika kesusahan itu datang daripada kesilapan sendiri dan anda menyedarinya. Ia mengakui kesalahan tanpa berhujah.
asb: Diseru dari dalam perut ikan, dalam kegelapan malam, laut dan perut — setelah baginda meninggalkan kaumnya dalam keadaan marah.
art: Deep water seen from below, one shaft of light reaching down and stopping short. No figure, no fish.
tr: lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina l-ẓālimīna
en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
my: Sesungguhnya tiada Tuhan (yang dapat menolong) melainkan Engkau (ya Allah)! Maha Suci Engkau (daripada melakukan aniaya, tolongkanlah daku)! Sesungguhnya aku adalah dari orang-orang yang menganiaya diri sendiri.

_note: The istirja', said on hearing of a death or a loss. Kept under the zikir kind so it carries the counter, with no target: it is said when the news comes, not a set number of times.
pen: The words said on hearing of a death: what was never ours going back where it came from.
ken: Said on hearing of a death, and on any loss — work, money, a thing you were holding. It returns the thing rather than protesting it.
aen: Named in the verse as what the patient say when disaster strikes them, in the passage on trial by fear, hunger and loss.
p: Kalimah yang diucapkan ketika mendengar berita kematian: apa yang tidak pernah menjadi milik kita kembali kepada pemiliknya.
keg: Dibaca ketika mendengar berita kematian, dan ketika apa-apa kehilangan — kerja, harta, sesuatu yang berada dalam pegangan anda. Ia memulangkan, bukan membantah.
asb: Disebut dalam ayat sebagai ucapan orang yang sabar apabila ditimpa musibah, dalam rangkaian ayat tentang ujian ketakutan, kelaparan dan kehilangan.
art: An empty chair by a window in flat afternoon light, one cup left on the sill. No person.
en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return.
my: Sesungguhnya kami adalah kepunyaan Allah dan kepada Allah jualah kami kembali.
